concepts.why: The patient has a positive urinalysis and blood and urine cultures that grow Escherichia coli, which supports the diagnosis of a urinary tract infection.
The patient's blood and urine cultures grow Escherichia coli, which supports the diagnosis of an E. coli infection.

The patient has a non-obstructing right nephrolithiasis, which supports the diagnosis of nephrolithiasis.
The patient is on immunosuppressive therapy and has a urinary tract infection, which supports the diagnosis of an immunosuppression-related urinary tract infection.
The patient has a leukocytosis and a positive blood culture, which supports the diagnosis of sepsis.
The patient has a history of severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, which supports the diagnosis of COPD.
